feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 September 2026 11:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 03 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the east this afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 in all waters overnight and occasionally 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then an area of rain developing through the afternoon, heavy at times, then becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east at first, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, perhaps rough in the east at first, becoming mainly slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
